_note: Tier-1 sweep batch 006, September-October 2023: RiSqvsbEUSE, 5CWynywOvK0, iVIxnrS3CmE, OtfM_l7fMfI, zFl169zNzhI, XxwF--X7PLo. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: Coming miracles will be large enough to belong in a next chapter of the Bible, including people being translated from one place to another to preach the gospel.
mentions.quote: trans people translating from one place to another going and preaching the gospel
mentions.falsify_match: Widely attested reports of bodily translation during a revival.

mentions.claim_text: Asked what to do, he says the instruction is to brag on God, praise him and draw attention to him, and to do it that night.
mentions.quote: brag on him praise the Lord brag on him lift him up
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; an instruction.

mentions.claim_text: He prays against a cyber attack on the electric grid reaching Miami, Los Angeles, Phoenix, Denver and Seattle, and declares over the warning that it will not happen.
mentions.quote: you're giving me right now I thank you Father that this will not happen
mentions.condition_text: he explicitly prays the warned event away
mentions.falsify_match: A cyber attack takes down grid capacity across several of the named cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: No multi-city grid cyber attack, which he pre-attributes to this prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He points back to a video he made on 5 July warning of a major volcano going off, now that an earthquake has struck Italy.
mentions.quote: back on July 5th I did a video about a major volcano going off
mentions.falsify_match: A major volcanic eruption in Italy after 5 July 2023.

mentions.claim_text: The volcano comes up out of the water, water rushes over the whole area causing great devastation, and all air traffic around it is completely shut down.
mentions.quote: it caused all the air traffic around that area was completely shut down
mentions.severity: regional flooding plus a full airspace closure
mentions.falsify_match: A submarine or coastal eruption in Italy floods the area and closes regional airspace.
mentions.falsify_miss: No eruption, or one without flooding or airspace closure.

mentions.claim_text: He reports that the biggest earthquake in forty years, a 4.2, struck that area this week, with hundreds of small quakes alongside it.
mentions.quote: the biggest earthquake in 40 years happened in that area
mentions.falsify_match: An M4.2 at Campi Flegrei in late September 2023, the largest there in forty years.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such quake in that week.

mentions.claim_text: A year before this, praying over the 2024 elections, he saw Michelle Obama and Gavin Newsom when neither was in the news.
mentions.quote: I saw Michelle Obama and I saw Gavin and nothing was in the news
mentions.falsify_match: Michelle Obama or Gavin Newsom becomes a central figure in the 2024 presidential race.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a well-connected figure and Ted Cruz both saying something along these lines in the same week, treating it as confirmation of the election word.
mentions.quote: she's in the In Crowd and so here she is saying it
mentions.falsify_match: Public speculation about a substitute Democratic nominee in that week.

mentions.claim_text: He was warned about the Saudi crown prince and oil going over two hundred dollars a barrel through a secret agreement with Russia and China and Saudi joining BRICS, which he says happened on 24 August.
mentions.quote: going over $200 a barrel of oil
mentions.time_phrase: BRICS accession 24 August 2023, oil price undated
mentions.falsify_match: Brent or WTI trades above $200 a barrel.
mentions.falsify_miss: Oil stays below $200 through the window.

mentions.claim_text: He feels strongly about the month of October and says a major event is coming around 4 October tied to the emergency alert that goes out on people's phones.
mentions.quote: I feel very strong about the month of October we have a major event coming
mentions.falsify_match: A major incident in the United States tied to or following the 4 October 2023 national alert test.
mentions.falsify_miss: The alert test passes without incident.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for godly leaders over the economy, naming the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, and for an awakening to God across the nation.
mentions.quote: we thank you for Godly leaders in this economy
mentions.falsify_match: Not independently scoreable; an intercession over officeholders.

mentions.claim_text: People who come through a refiner's fire will rise up and lay hands on the sick, filling heaven and emptying hell.
mentions.quote: that will rise up in this refiners fire and lay hands on the sick
mentions.falsify_match: A healing movement of that scale becomes visible.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that he was warned about gas prices and about oil reaching two hundred dollars a barrel.
mentions.quote: he warned me about $200 for a barrel of oil
mentions.falsify_match: Oil trades above $200 a barrel.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw this back in May and describes seeing in the spirit as having depth perception, seeing in part and hearing in part.
mentions.quote: there's a depth perception of things you see in part, you hear in part
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; a statement about how he receives things.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not scoreable; a statement about method.

mentions.claim_text: In about May of the previous year the Lord told him 24 August is a very significant day and to pray over it, without saying why.
mentions.quote: August the 24th is a very significant day
mentions.falsify_match: A significant geopolitical event dated 24 August 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He says, marking it as a feeling rather than a prophetic word, that the Lord will give a season of somewhere between one and two years.
mentions.quote: Whether it's a year, a year and a half, or two years
mentions.time_phrase: one to two years from September 2023
mentions.falsify_match: A recognisable window of favour running one to two years from September 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He says listeners will not be looking for what comes, and that his spiritual year for 2024 runs from Rosh Hashanah 2023 to Rosh Hashanah 2024.
mentions.quote: you will not be looking for this
mentions.falsify_match: A major unanticipated event inside that feast-to-feast year.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts a dream in which an angel said great judgment is coming in 569 days, and counts that to 2 October.
mentions.quote: There's great judgment coming. And he said, in 569 days
mentions.time_phrase: 569 days from the dream, landing 2 October
mentions.falsify_match: An event recognisable as great judgment on or about 2 October 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: That date passes without such an event.

mentions.claim_text: He says the angel would not tell him what the judgment is, that the Lord gives it in pieces as he intercedes, and that the count came about in August.
mentions.quote: he will give it to you in pieces
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable on its own; it explains why the 569-day claim has no content.

mentions.claim_text: When Saudi Arabia goes full swing with the BRICS nations alongside the UAE and Egypt, the oil trade shifts and the dollar's position fades.
mentions.quote: when Saudi Arabia starts to go full swing with the BRICS nations
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on Saudi BRICS accession taking full effect
mentions.falsify_match: Saudi oil sales shift materially out of dollars after BRICS accession.

mentions.claim_text: In January the Lord told him the beginning of the digital dollar would be seen in 2023.
mentions.quote: You will start to see the beginning of the digital dollar in 2023
mentions.falsify_match: A visible first step toward a US digital dollar during 2023.

mentions.claim_text: The indictments run clear into the summer and get very serious, and he saw himself praying over Trump's life.
mentions.quote: the indictments will go clear into the summer
mentions.falsify_match: Trump indictment proceedings continue through summer 2024 and escalate.
mentions.falsify_miss: The cases resolve or lapse before summer 2024.

mentions.claim_text: Everything that was being held back is released in 2025, which he saw as a sludge of filth, and he tells listeners to be prepared.
mentions.quote: everything that was being held back was going to be released in 2025
mentions.falsify_match: A mass release of suppressed material in 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He gives as his own opinion that a two-state solution will be agreed between September and some point in 2024.
mentions.quote: we will see a two-state solution become agreed upon
mentions.falsify_match: A two-state agreement is reached by the end of 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He expects a big turnaround of things and allows that Jesus could return at any moment, including in September, while noting no one knows the day or hour.
mentions.quote: we'll start to see a big turnaround of things
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable by ordinary evidence; explicitly hedged.
